Title: Lunatic Eruption and Temptation (or any control change effect)

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
So I have Tempted several vampires with Lunatic Eruptions on them. If I
burn the counters to take control of the Tempted vampires during my
minion phase after I've taking lots of non-mandatory actions, are they
required to enter combat with my prey's minions immediately or has that
mandatory action requirement passed?

Thanks in advance.

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The former. [6]

Similarly, if you rescue an empty untapped vampire from torpor, that
vampire must then hunt.
